title: Samantha vs The Liver Doc | Hydrogen Peroxide Controversy Explained #ayurveda #debate #liverdoc
tags: Liver Doc vs Samantha Ruth Prabhu
description:
This week, a storm erupted on Twitter (X) — a battle of tweets between actress Samantha Ruth Prabhu and Dr. Cyriac Abby Philips (Liver Doc). What began as a celebrity post about “alternative therapy” turned into a viral debate on pseudoscience, public health, and accountability.

Samantha, with over 35 million Instagram followers, shared that nebulizing hydrogen peroxide mixed with water was a “magical” cure for viral infections. Problem? Hydrogen peroxide is a corrosive disinfectant meant for external use only. Inhaling it can burn lung tissue, damage cilia, and worsen respiratory illnesses. Yet her post framed it as a harmless alternative to pills.

Enter Liver Doc, a hepatologist known for busting pseudoscience. He responded with evidence from the Asthma and Allergy Foundation of America, warning against inhaling hydrogen peroxide. He condemned Samantha’s advice as dangerous disinformation, pointing out that in a rational society, celebrities spreading such claims could face legal action.

The spat escalated when Samantha doubled down with a three-page response, playing the victim card and citing dubious doctors promoting ozone therapy, IV cocktails, and naturopathy. Liver Doc exposed these “experts” and clarified why pseudoscience marketed as wellness is a public health hazard.

If you’ve searched for Liver Doc vs Samantha Ruth Prabhu, hydrogen peroxide inhalation danger, celebrity health misinformation, pseudoscience exposed India, or Dr. Cyriac Abby Philips busting myths, this documentary covers the facts, science, and fallout.
